name: Chaos Monks
summary:
Chaos Monks is a wild, action-packed game where you can swing into a variety of fun game modes—whether you're playing solo, teaming up with friends, or jumping into public lobbies with players from around the world. From high-energy challenges to laid-back hangouts, there’s always something to dive into.

Whether you’re playing alone or with others, Chaos Monks offers endless ways to have fun, explore, and unleash your inner monkey. The chaos never stops, and neither will the laughs!
